title: Liquid d1-3B GGUF on llama.cpp (2.9 GB)
slug_note: llama-server serves d1 on /v1/systemone; 8 ms per decision on an RTX 4090 (card).

variation.quant_detail: Q8_0, 2.87 GB (+ vision projector 0.58-0.86 GB); Q4_K_M 1.67 GB

engine.config: llama-server, /v1/systemone (decision support merged in llama.cpp PR #30110, 2026-10-07)

steps.text: Install llama.cpp (see Step 0 in Quick start); use a build from 2026-10-07 or later for d1 support.

caveats: Decision model: it answers typed questions with probabilities on /v1/systemone; it does not chat, so OpenCode and chat UIs cannot use it.
Speed figures are Liquid's own table (RTX 4090 8 ms, M5 Pro 30 ms per decision).
